items.subEn: Sharpest reactions follow technical errors — loose touch, mistimed run — not personal slights

items.subEn: Mars in Cancer routes competitive push through covering teammates and shielding the group, not chasing solo glory

items.subEn: He names what the team should have done — Virgo's service-via-craft instinct showing up as leadership, not ego
items.subZh: 他会直接说出团队本应怎么做——处女座通过技艺服务的本能以领导力而非自我膨胀的方式呈现

linesEn: He is a hot-headed fire sign
Frustration and calm interviews contradict each other

linesEn: Earth-sign Virgo perfectionist — flashpoints come from precision falling short, not a short fuse
Rising is packaging; the Virgo Sun is the operator, exacting rather than explosive
Libra Moon handles the public side; Virgo Sun drives in-game quality control — both can be true at once
Holding teammates to a high consistent standard is Virgo's way of serving the group, not undermining it
linesZh: 土象处女座完美主义者——爆发点来自精准度未达内在标准，而非性格急躁
上升星座是外包装；处女座太阳才是驱动核心，一丝不苟而非易爆
天秤座月亮处理公众面；处女座太阳驱动赛场质量把控——两者可以同时为真
对队友保持高一致标准是处女座服务团队的方式，而非破坏团队
